presets.name: Windows Media Foundation 1080p30 (H.265)
presets.description: Aimed at Windows playback: the file is encoded in software and the finished MP4 is handed to Media Foundation for hardware decoding, which is where the speed-up on a Windows machine comes from.
presets.compatibility: Windows players that decode H.265 through Media Foundation; the media tools expose Media Foundation as a decoder, not as a video encoder, so this preset encodes in software.

presets.compatibility: A Mac whose media tools expose VideoToolbox; everywhere else this preset falls back to the software encoder.

presets.name: ProRes Proxy
presets.description: Half-resolution 10-bit 4:2:2 for an editor to work with. Not for showing anyone. Audio is uncompressed PCM so an edit never has to undo a lossy step first.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads ProRes in Matroska. Very large files by design.

presets.name: ProRes LT
presets.description: Lightweight 10-bit 4:2:2 for an editor who needs the look without the size. Audio is uncompressed PCM so an edit never has to undo a lossy step first.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads ProRes in Matroska. Very large files by design.

presets.name: ProRes 422
presets.description: Full-resolution 10-bit 4:2:2, the everyday editing interchange. Audio is uncompressed PCM so an edit never has to undo a lossy step first.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads ProRes in Matroska. Very large files by design.

presets.name: DNxHR LB
presets.description: The smallest of the three, for an editor that only needs to see the edit. Audio is uncompressed PCM, as it is for ProRes.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads DNxHR in Matroska.

presets.name: DNxHR SQ
presets.description: A middle rung: full resolution at 8-bit for a timeline that does not need more. Audio is uncompressed PCM, as it is for ProRes.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads DNxHR in Matroska.

presets.name: DNxHR HQX
presets.description: Full-resolution 10-bit 4:2:2 for a master that goes to a finishing stage. Audio is uncompressed PCM, as it is for ProRes.
presets.compatibility: Editing software that reads DNxHR in Matroska.

presets.name: FFV1 preservation with PCM audio
presets.description: FFV1 is lossless and intra-only, so every frame stands on its own and an archive can be cut at any point without generating a new file. PCM keeps the audio bit-for-bit, which is the point of a preservation copy.
presets.compatibility: Archive and mastering tools. The files are very large and encode slowly; that is what preservation costs.

presets.name: FFV1 preservation with FLAC audio
presets.description: FFV1 is lossless and intra-only, so every frame stands on its own and an archive can be cut at any point without generating a new file. FLAC keeps the audio lossless at roughly half the size PCM takes.
presets.compatibility: Archive and mastering tools. The files are very large and encode slowly; that is what preservation costs.

presets.name: FFV1 preservation 4K, with PCM audio
presets.description: FFV1 is lossless and intra-only, so every frame stands on its own and an archive can be cut at any point without generating a new file. The same preservation master for 4K sources, which take a great deal longer to write.
presets.compatibility: Archive and mastering tools. The files are very large and encode slowly; that is what preservation costs.

presets.name: Production H.264 1080p30 (medium)
presets.description: H.264 for a finished master rather than a delivery file: the encoder is given a longer preset and a lower quality number because the result is kept, not streamed.
presets.compatibility: Any player that reads MP4; kept rather than delivered, so the file is larger than a streaming copy.
